# Conservation budgets and diagnostics {#sec-ch13}

<!-- PROVENANCE
pin: snapy@919936da07d80a310b98ab11da184972a3203274 (chengcli/snapy)
sources: OUTLINE.md 13
status: draft
-->

This chapter describes what snapy measures and prints about its own conservation, and which regression tests
read those numbers. Every `ncycle_out`[^rg-f6dd05c80d82] cycles the driver prints one line. It holds the volume integrals of the
conserved state (`mass0=`, `masst=`, `ke=`, `ie=` or `energy=`, `pe=`) and a group of run-to-date meters
(`limcut=`, `thetamin=`, `thetasevere=`, `vicclamp=`, and `fixgrav=` while the gravity-work fixer is on). The chapter also covers the gravity-work fixer
budget, the redo causes and termination status as a diagnostic view, the diagnostic fields an output block can
request, and the tests that assert conservation to round-off.

The chapter owns the bookkeeping and the printout, not the schemes being measured. The positivity
limiter belongs to @sec-ch08, the VIC[^rg-a857d6ac8b55] and the step acceptance to @sec-ch07, and the physics of the gravity-work
fixer to @sec-ch06-fixer.
The directory `src/diagnostics/` is legacy code from Athena++ and canoe. It is not in the library's source glob,
`src_files` ({{< code src/CMakeLists.txt >}}), so it is not compiled, and nothing in it is described here as live.

| scheme | switch | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cycle-line budget (@sec-ch13-cycle) | `integration/ncycle_out` | pyharp default | — | `test_cycle_diagnostics` |
| Positivity-limiter meters (@sec-ch13-limiter-meters) | `equation-of-state/limiter`, or the face-flux covariance | on with species in 2-D and 3-D (covariance rows); with `limiter: true` in 1-D | — | `test_cycle_diagnostics` |
| VIC clamp meter (@sec-ch13-vicclamp) | `integration/implicit-scheme` | off | — | `test_cycle_diagnostics` |
| Gravity-work fixer budget (@sec-ch13-fixgrav) | `gravity-work-fixer`[^rg-28d2a2d75ede] | on with `cell`; the default form is `face` ({{< code src/forcing/const_gravity.cpp ConstGravityOptionsImpl::from_yaml >}}) | — | `test_gravity_work_fixer_python` |
| Redo causes and termination status (@sec-ch13-redo-view) | none | on | — | `test_check_redo_floor_python` |
| Output-field diagnostics (@sec-ch13-output-diag) | `outputs/N/variables` | none | — | `test_user_output` |
| Mass-conservation regression checks (@sec-ch13-regression) | none | — | — | `test_flux_positivity_python` |

<!-- reader glossary notes -->
[^rg-f6dd05c80d82]: ncycle_out — number of cycles between printed cycle lines; 0 turns the line off

[^rg-a857d6ac8b55]: VIC — vertically implicit correction

[^rg-28d2a2d75ede]: gravity-work-fixer — whether the gravity-work fixer runs (a boolean; default true with `gravity-work: cell`, and it needs `cell`)
<!-- end reader glossary notes -->
